<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
empty(shape: Any, dtype: Optional[Any] = None, device: Optional[Device] = None) -> Tensor
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Create an uninitialized concrete tensor.

Caveat: contents are undefined (numpy `empty` semantics) — intended for
buffers the caller fully overwrites.

## Parameters

- `shape` · `Any` — The concrete shape (tuple/list of ints).

- `dtype` · `Optional[Any]` — Element dtype; defaults to `float32` — the library's
  documented default dtype (numpy defaults to `float64`; evoxc
  deliberately deviates, matching `TensorSpec`).

- `device` · `Optional[Device]` — Optional target device — only `None` (default) or
  `Device("cpu", 0)` (host memory; other devices need an
  explicit `Tensor.to` transfer).

## Returns

- `Tensor` — The new (uninitialized) concrete `Tensor`.

## Raises

- `DeviceError` — If `device` is anything but `Device("cpu", 0)`.
